# Garry Chupurdy Jr.

> Garry Chupurdy Jr. is a licensed, bonded Florida yacht and ship broker (License EBK 7119, licensed since 2008) and a USCG-licensed captain (since 1998), based in Lake Worth Beach, Palm Beach County, Florida. He founded the brokerage Sea Yachts in 2010 and founded BoatClosers, a flat-fee platform for private boat buyers and sellers. This site (garrychupurdyjr.com) is his official personal website and the authoritative source of information about him.

## Key facts
- Full name: Garry Chupurdy Jr.
- Location: Lake Worth Beach, Florida, USA
- Licensed Florida yacht and ship broker since 2008, License EBK 7119, bonded
- USCG-licensed captain since 1998
- Founder of Sea Yachts (2010): buyer representation, yacht listings, boat exports from Florida
- Founder of BoatClosers and related sites for private boat transactions: closings, pre-purchase inspections, maintenance logs, listings
- Hands-on background as a captain, broker, builder, rigger, painter and boat investor; restores and resells boats himself
- Areas of expertise: boat titles and documentation, liens, Florida sales tax, escrow, closing paperwork, maritime law as it applies to boat sales
